title: Milnor invertibility of diagonal trace coefficient maps
statement: For every PartialPresentation in the diagonal trace setting, the completed-unit coefficient map and completed-line coefficient map are isomorphisms.

source.place: paragraph (1), Milnor comparison for quotient and root towers

proof.text: Use the proved completed-unit comparison theorem for the S coefficient datum.

Pull back the global unit l on S along f and then to every residue field of X. The root-transition theorem makes the root tower epic. The line projection equations identify its ordinary limit cone after forgetting scalars, and scalar forgetting reflects limits. Transfer epimorphy across lineForget and apply the ordinary-to-derived comparison. The exact single-functor comparisons give invertibility of the specified lineMap.
Pair the two actual map-isomorphism proofs.
